representation.choice: Keep the existing accumulated string, search only the incoming decoded chunk for the first newline, then retain the original suffix loop. String length does not require a prefix search. No fragment arrays or indexed access to accumulated text before a newline.
representation.reason: An offset indexOf on the accumulated rope can still flatten it. Searching the new chunk instead avoids that trigger until a newline requires slicing and JSON parsing. No claim of engine-independent copy counts; measured on the supplied Node 24 runtime.
representation.limits: Unchanged whole incoming chunk UTF-16 length check, performed before parsing even if the chunk contains complete early lines. Existing over-limit and malformed-response behaviors remain, including suffix processing after parse errors.
representation.lifecycle: Clear partial string only on confirmed child close. Preserve partial line across explicit cancellation/error close because a still-exiting child can complete that line. Pending rejection, timers, SIGTERM/SIGKILL escalation and exited promise remain unchanged.

shortLineInterpretation.verdict: No material ordinary short-line regression observed in eight alternating-order samples of 30000 complete lines each; noisy fixture timings are not a universal performance guarantee. Same 60000 searches and 240000 search input units.
